questions.stem: In cholecystectomy, why does it matter whether the gallbladder is acute ('hot') or not?
questions.answer: It affects aspiration risk and surgical difficulty

questions.stem: What does an intraoperative cholangiogram (IOC) during cholecystectomy need?
What share of cholecystectomies begin as open operations?
What is the usual conversion rate from laparoscopic to open cholecystectomy?
questions.answer: About 5%, up to 10% in acute cholecystitis

questions.stem: Name the causes for converting a laparoscopic cholecystectomy to open surgery.
questions.answer: Adhesions, unclear cystic duct anatomy, suspected bile duct injury, uncontrolled cystic artery bleeding, common bile duct stones, acute inflammation

What classic mnemonic describes the typical patient for laparoscopic cholecystectomy?
questions.answer: Female, forty, fair, fat and fertile

questions.answer: Usually self-limiting; NSAIDs if not contraindicated
